tweets.author: @ammaar
tweets.text:
I used Fable 5 to port Command & Conquer: Generals Zero Hour to the iPhone and iPad!

This is the actual 2003 engine compiled for ARM64 natively, no emulator.

Campaign, skirmish, Generals Challenge all work with touch controls built for an RTS.

Open sourcing it all below!

We've created a comprehensive Retrieval Harness for modern agentic retrieval in 2026.

The harness provides a persistent data pipeline that can connect to a data source, index and update a large knowledge base, and expose a broad set of tools akin to filesystem operations
